# add git upstream command

Add `git upstream <url>`, which registers or re-points the `upstream` remote — the parent repository of a fork — in one idempotent command:

```
$ git upstream git@github.com:goreleaser/godownloader.git
# git remote add upstream git@github.com:goreleaser/godownloader.git
# or
# git remote set-url upstream git@github.com:goreleaser/godownloader.git
```

It is the fork-side twin of `git mirror` ([[DOT-36]]); the author's remotes policy ([[DOT-137]]) additionally wants `upstream` configured fetch-only so that `push` need not filter it out.
